capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Jalopnik: "106 kWh of usable capacity" on both GT trims (AutoGuide, InsideEVs, KBB give 106 kWh without the label). Mercedes pages not opened.

chemistry.notes: Jalopnik/InsideEVs: NCMA cathode (nickel cobalt manganese aluminium) with silicon anode; recorded as nmc (the schema enum has no NCMA value, so nmc is coarser than the page).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Jalopnik: 800-volt pack (also charges at 400 V stations).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: The 2026 CLA release states navigation-triggered battery pre-heating before DC fast charging; no page was found for this car and Mercedes states no lineup-wide feature for this year, so this is a same-maker guess. Manual control unknown. No AMG GT page mentions it.

dc_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs: 600 kW peak; Jalopnik: more than 600 kW. (The GT SUV, a different car, is 710 kW.)

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia lists an 11 kW AC onboard charger for the electric GT 4-Door without naming a market; no US page found (Jalopnik, KBB, InsideEVs, AutoGuide, Electrek silent). The US spec could differ: every US Mercedes EV on mbusa lists 9.6 kW. Low confidence.

published_10_80_min.notes: AMG claim of about 11 minutes 10-80 % (InsideEVs, AutoGuide).
